network.name: local fixturenet (Anvil hub chain, mock CCTP)

proofPolicy.summary: All transact/unshield vectors captured with testingMode proof bypass active (spec §5.6 step 1): proofs are zero structs and calldata is replayable without circuit artifacts. Shield/admin/shield-in vectors need no proofs.

notes: Replay order: topologically sort `vectors` by dependsOn (the array order below is already a valid execution order).
Address substitution: calldata embeds capture-time addresses; replay on a new deployment must re-encode decodedCall.args with the new addressBook (labels in tx.from/to + addressBook).
Vectors with requiresImpersonation must be sent from an impersonated account (hardhat_impersonateAccount / anvil_impersonateAccount).
Merkle rollover (treeNumber > 0) is NOT covered: reaching it needs >65,536 leaf insertions (~100+ full blocks of batch inserts) — see OQ-1 and README 'Uncovered'.

vectors.description: Owner wires the CCTPHookRouter into the pool (required for inbound cross-chain shields; deploy script leaves this unset).

Mock-CCTP wiring (not a pool call): point the hub MockMessageTransmitterV2's relayer at the CCTPHookRouter so relayWithHook can call receiveMessage. Recorded for replay completeness; identical in old/new deployments.
Owner registers a remote pool for CCTP domain 101 (dummy client-pool address; required by atomicCrossChainUnshield). Emits RemotePoolSet.
Owner sets defaultFinalityThreshold to 1000 (FAST). Emits DefaultFinalityThresholdSet. Affects atomicCrossChainUnshield's depositForBurnWithHook finality argument.
Owner raises the flat shield fee 50 -> 100 bps. No event is emitted (spec §5.4).
setShieldFee(10001) exceeds the 10000 bps cap and reverts (I-10, OQ-10).
Owner restores the flat shield fee to 50 bps for the shield vectors.
Owner detaches ArmadaFeeModule (deploy_fee_module.ts wired it in) so flat-fee shield paths can be captured. Emits FeeModuleSet.

Owner enables the testingMode proof bypass. Emits TestingModeSet TWICE per call (module delegatecall + router — OQ-8). All subsequent transact/unshield vectors run with proofs bypassed (spec §5.6 step 1).
Owner registers a dummy verifying key for the unused (9,9) shape via the VerifierModule delegatecall. Emits VerifyingKeySet; no structural validation (spec §9.1).
Owner marks CAROL as a privileged shield caller (fee-free shields, spec §7.3). No event.
Non-owner (ALICE) calling an admin setter reverts with the router-level owner guard.
Direct ERC20 shield of 100 USDC with the flat 50 bps fee: base 99.5 USDC to pool, 0.5 USDC fee to treasury (I-5, I-10).
Shield of 199 base units at 50 bps: floor division makes the fee exactly 0 (I-10, Lean fee_zero_below_threshold).
Two shield requests in one call (5 + 7 USDC): single Shield event with two entries, two leaves inserted atomically.
Privileged caller (CAROL) shields 10 USDC: full value committed, zero fee (spec §7.3 privileged branch).

Gasless shield: BOB signs an EIP-2612 permit for 20 USDC; the relayer (DEPLOYER) calls GaslessShieldWrapper.gaslessShield, which pulls 1 USDC relayer fee and shields 19 USDC into the pool (flat 50 bps pool fee applies).
Owner re-attaches ArmadaFeeModule so the fee-module shield path (spec §7.3) can be captured. Emits FeeModuleSet.
Shield of 1000 USDC with ArmadaFeeModule active (integrator=0): base tier 50 bps armadaTake to treasury, recordShieldFee bookkeeping call (spec §7.3 fee-module branch).
npk exactly equal to SNARK_SCALAR_FIELD is rejected (I-7 boundary: npk must be < field).
ERC721 token type passes preimage validation (value==1, npk valid) but the token pull requires ERC20 (OQ-6 dead NFT path).
Zero-value shield is rejected before any token movement.
Empty request batch is rejected.

Two 1x1 transactions in one transact call: two Nullified events, single batched Transact event with both commitments (spec §8.1 steps 5-7).
Replaying the exact calldata of transact-1x1 reverts: its nullifier is already marked (I-4). The old merkle root remains valid in rootHistory (I-2), so validation reaches the nullifier check.
Transaction over a root that was never inserted reverts at validation step 4 (spec §8.3).
boundParams.chainID != block.chainid reverts at validation step 3 (spec §8.3).
Empty transaction batch is rejected (spec §8.1 step 1).
Local unshield of 25 USDC to BOB (1x2 shape, unshield=NORMAL): last commitment is the unshield-output note hash (not inserted); Unshield event with fee=0 (D-2).
Local unshield with unshield=REDIRECT: hash check binds msg.sender (DEPLOYER), but the 30 USDC payout goes to the npk-encoded address (BOB) — spec §8.3 step 6 note.
Local unshield of 5 USDC to a contract recipient (GASLESS_WRAPPER): plain ERC20 transfer, no callback expected or attempted (D-4).

Atomic cross-chain unshield of 50 USDC to BOB on domain 101 via mock CCTP depositForBurnWithHook (maxFee 1 USDC, finality from defaultFinalityThreshold=1000). Burns pool USDC, emits CrossChainUnshieldInitiated + Unshield, returns nonce=0 (spec §8.2).
atomicCrossChainUnshield to unregistered domain 199 reverts before proof validation (spec §8.2 check 4).

Inbound cross-chain shield at STANDARD finality (2000) routed to handleReceiveFinalizedMessage, fee module active: 500 USDC gross, 2 USDC CCTP fee minted to hookRouter, 498 USDC minted to pool; armadaTake (50 bps of 498) paid to treasury OUT OF the pool's own balance (spec §7.2 note).
Owner detaches the fee module again so the fast-finality shield-in vector exercises the flat-fee path.

Inbound cross-chain shield at FAST finality (1000) routed to handleReceiveUnfinalizedMessage, flat 50 bps fee: 300 USDC gross, 1 USDC CCTP fee to hookRouter, 299 USDC minted to pool; shield fee paid from the pool's own balance to treasury.
handleReceiveFinalizedMessage with finalityThresholdExecuted=1000 (< STANDARD 2000) reverts (spec §5.3 step 2).
handleReceiveUnfinalizedMessage from an EOA that is neither hookRouter nor tokenMessenger reverts (spec §5.3 step 1).
Inbound CCTP payload with messageType=UNSHIELD reverts on the hub — it only accepts SHIELD payloads (spec §5.3 step 5).

Owner points shieldPauseContract at a MockShieldPauseController (capture-only mock with permissionless flag setters; the real ShieldPauseController is security-council gated). Emits ShieldPauseContractSet.
Shield while shieldsPaused()=true reverts before any token movement (spec §7.1 step 1).
Transact with unshield=NONE while withdrawOnlyMode()=true reverts (spec §8.1 step 3).
Unshield transaction SUCCEEDS while withdrawOnlyMode()=true — the mode only blocks unshield=NONE (spec §8.1 step 3).
Any transact — including unshields — reverts while emergencyPaused()=true (spec §8.1 step 2).
Owner clears shieldPauseContract back to address(0), disabling all three pause checks (spec §10).
Direct external call to the router's insertLeaves reverts — tree mutation is self-call gated (I-9).
Calling ShieldModule.shield directly (not via router delegatecall) trips the onlyDelegatecall guard (I-9).
Owner points feeModule at the capture-only MockConfigurableFeeModule (mode=1: totalFee = amount + 1).
Fee module returning totalFee > amount: base = value - totalFee underflows → Panic(0x11) bubbled verbatim through the router (spec §7.3, §5.7). No tokens move (I-8).
Fee module whose calculateShieldFee reverts: the module's revert string bubbles verbatim through the router's delegatecall helper (spec §5.7).
Owner detaches the malformed mock fee module (cleanup; end state feeModule = 0).
Owner disables testingMode (cleanup): real SNARK verification restored; double TestingModeSet emission again (OQ-8). Final state matches the deployed fixturenet plus captured history.
